purpose: Analyze high-priority Dragonflight prospecting dropChance/expectedQuantity conflicts without converting historical source units into asserted current-Retail facts; preserve joint-cast co-output covariance and Resourcefulness refund denominators.

functions.historicalRateAlternatives: Preserves PER_INPUT, PER_CAST, UNKNOWN as separate hypotheses. Converts only conditional hypothetical E per cast; no invented P or Retail E. Normalizes duplicate lineage strings for distinct-source count. Hypothetical rate multiplication overflow is rejected.
functions.analyzeCasts: Requires full zero-inclusive completed-cast vectors, distinct cast IDs, explicit aborted requests, typed patch/recipe/quality/skill/profession context, refund counts and caller-attested output universe. Computes marginal P, unconditional E, positive observed extrema, sample covariance and descriptive sample margin distribution. Full typed context is validated recursively as JSON-safe and snapshotted with contextIdentity; nonfinite result arithmetic fails closed. Version 1.0.2 rejects array subclasses, sparse indices, own symbol/hidden metadata, custom toJSON hooks and getter-backed object fields before context serialization.
functions.scenarioBounds: Uses full caller-attested output universe and unconditional E intervals with price/cost/refund sensitivity; no marginal probability double-multiplication and no independence assumption for expected linear revenue. Exact output quality rank equality is required, and nonfinite revenues, costs and margins fail closed.

math.P: number of completed casts with output>0 / actual completed casts
math.E: sum output counts including zero casts / actual completed casts
math.scenarioMargin: revenue - input opportunity cost - alternative value

applicability: Research-only, exact same character profile/patch/recipe/rank/source cohort; no pooling across unknown skill or patch; recipe IDs and output universe are caller assertions, not independent evidence. RAW_CURRENT_RETAIL requires a fully anchored dotted numeric patch/build; malformed suffixes rejected.

uncertainty.unverifiedSourceUnit: Keep both hypotheses; do not average
uncertainty.observedPositiveMinMax: Sample extrema only, not hard game bounds
uncertainty.completeOutputUniverse: Caller attestation is not independent proof
uncertainty.goldImpact: Synthetic sensitivity only, not measured AH prices
uncertainty.contextSerialization: Context JSON safety requires ordinary dense arrays with exactly native length plus own enumerable data indices, plain objects with enumerable data properties, no symbols, cycles, nonfinite numbers, or own/inherited toJSON hooks. Semantic validation runs after serialization safety checks. Snapshot identity still caller-attested and not independent proof.
